header: # Ludlow -- item-9 follow-up, 2026-10-22; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Ludlow, 'FY25 Town Appointed & Elected Officers' list: the Board of Cemetery Commissioners is Robert Brandt (elected), Bruce Schmidt, Chair (elected, term to 2029), Shannon Stark (elected, 2028), Scott Baitz (appointed) and Ludwig Gabranski (elected, term to 2026). Gabranski was missed by the earlier builds; he no longer sits -- George Tucker, Jr. joined the commission between March 18 and July 15, 2026, consistent with a vacancy appointment to Gabranski's seat -- so this membership is ended in 2026 (the hand-edits step adds the end).
